newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume buoyant on easier prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume buoyant on easier prices.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange trade volume was down marginally from Tuesday's 1,965 kg, but remained buoyant at 1,527 kg as prices fell, encouraging arbitrage deals as well as some physical demand, dealers said.
Gold eased to $356.50 an ounce and 1,424,000 lira per gramme against $360.15 and 1,436,500 following lower levels in European markets.
The Turkish lira eased to 124,070 to the dollar, from 123,710 lira at Tuesday's close.
Of the day's total trade, 987 kg changed hands in the morning session and 76.4 percent of the total turnover was conducted in lira terms.
